advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Update test_bug_review_tier.py module docstring so 'NEVER blocks a bug' reflects the new P4 oversize-description block exception.
evidence: docstring context: 'The bug tier instead runs the DET floor + the advisory `necessity` probe (`registry.BUG_TIER_CRITERIA`) and NEVER blocks a bug.'
workflow_ops.py: 'every DET finding EXCEPT P4's description admission limit is downgraded to advisory, so an ordinarily sized bug always PASSes'
updated bullet only qualifies 'an ordinarily sized bug emits ... det_blocking==[]', leaving the blanket 'NEVER blocks a bug' claim stale
advisory.finding: The test module docstring still asserts the bug tier 'NEVER blocks a bug', but the reviewed change makes an oversize bug (description above the P4 admission limit) block, contradicting that claim.
scenarios: A reader relies on the module docstring to believe bugs are structurally non-blockable, but an oversize bug now BLOCKs.
advisory.suggested_fix: Reword the docstring to 'never blocks an ordinarily sized bug (P4's description admission limit is the one deterministic block that survives)'.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a bug-tier test where the DET floor produces a NON-P4 blocking finding and assert it is downgraded into det_advisory (det_blocking excludes it).
evidence: workflow_ops.py:136-138 `det_blocks = [finding for finding in all_det_blocks if finding["criteria"] == ["P4"]]` / `downgraded = [... != ["P4"]]` / `det_advisories = [*downgraded, *det_advisories]`
test_bug_review_tier.py:81-90 clean bug asserts `out["det_blocking"] == []` but `_BUG_DESC` has AC + reproduction, so it produces no DET block — the downgrade branch is never forced
ABSENCE: the parametrized `test_plan_precheck_blocks_every_oversize_work_ticket_without_llm` bug case only triggers a P4 block (the kept path), never the non-P4 downgrade path
advisory.finding: The changed bug-tier partition (keep P4 description blocks, downgrade every other DET block to advisory) is not regression-covered: no test exercises a bug that triggers a NON-P4 blocking DET finding and asserts it is moved into det_advisory with det_blocking excluding it. The clean-bug test asserts det_blocking==[] on a well-formed description that produces no DET blocks at all, so it cannot detect a regression where a non-P4 block leaks into det_blocking (or is dropped) for a bug.
scenarios: A bug with a missing Acceptance Criteria checklist (P1) or a P8/P10/P11 block: a regression that fails to downgrade it (blocking a bug) or drops it entirely would pass all current tests.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a test: bug ticket with a missing-AC (P1) or P8-triggering description that is under the size limit; assert det_blocking==[] AND that the P1/P8 finding appears in det_advisory.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a completion_precheck boundary test asserting a description exactly AT the limit is admitted (run_verify=True) and limit+1 is rejected.
evidence: test_ticket_description_limit.py:175-201 only asserts the 5001 (over-limit) case; no at-limit (accept) or limit+1 boundary pair for completion_precheck
advisory.finding: The completion-path admission limit boundary is not tested: only one over-limit value (5001) is asserted. The strict `>` boundary in completion_precheck (accept AT the limit, reject at limit+1) — the analog of the plan-side 8000/8001 test — is uncovered on the completion path.
scenarios: A regression flipping `>` to `>=` on the completion path would reject a description exactly at the limit; no completion-path test would catch it (the plan-side 8000/8001 test does not exercise gate_ops).
advisory.suggested_fix: Parametrize test_completion_precheck over (limit → admitted, limit+1 → rejected) mirroring test_p4_allows_8000_and_blocks_8001.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the P4 advisory→blocking flip and 24,000→8,000 default-threshold drop is an intended, documented breaking change (migration: raise verify.max_ticket_description_chars or split tickets) rather than an accidental narrowing of accepted gate input.
evidence: det_floor.py old: `P4_DESC_SOFT_CAP_CHARS = 24_000` and docstring 'Advisory ... Never blocks'

det_floor.py new p4_oversize sets `blocking=description_over_limit` where `description_over_limit = chars > desc_limit` and `desc_limit` resolves to verify.max_ticket_description_chars (default 8_000, _config_schema.py:152)
gate_ops.py:81 `if description_chars > description_limit:` short-circuits completion_precheck to a FAIL verdict (run_verify=False) for the same limit — a new completion admission block
workflow_ops.py:136 preserves P4 as a real DET block even in the bug light tier: `det_blocks = [finding for finding in all_det_blocks if finding['criteria'] == ['P4']]`

Consumer path: plan-review gate short-circuit at workflow_ops.py:154 comment 'ANY DET gate producing a blocking finding stops the review' — a P4 block now yields a terminal BLOCK verdict for tickets that formerly passed
advisory.finding: P4 changes from advisory-only to a BLOCKING gate check and its effective description threshold drops from 24,000 chars (old P4_DESC_SOFT_CAP_CHARS) to the new default 8,000 (verify.max_ticket_description_chars). Work tickets whose description length falls in (8000, 24000] previously PASSED the plan-review DET floor and completion admission but now hard-BLOCK on both gates, changing existing behavior for callers who never set this key.
scenarios: An existing project with a 10,000-char ticket description that passed plan-review before this change now gets a hard BLOCK at claim/review time
The same ticket now FAILs completion admission (rebar close) via completion_precheck before any LLM verify runs
